control_flow: stopAtWall: if no obstacle is in front, stop both wheels; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10 %, 40 %); else curve right (40 %, 10 %).

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, and when a wall is right in front, stop before it without touching it and stay there.

decision_points.condition: no obstacle right in front (not the obstacle sensor FRONT)

branches.outcome: no obstacle in front: it stops both wheels
an obstacle is in front: it calls followLine and drives a curve
black under the line tracker: it curves left (10 %, 40 %)
no black under the line tracker: it curves right (40 %, 10 %)
